_doc: The Design BOM — every CSS custom property, colour literal, type value, viz-* family, brand asset and copy key MEASURED across both Muntin repos. Generated by scripts/build-design-inventory.mjs; never edit by hand — re-run the generator. NOT a gate: --check asserts the file matches the tree, not that the tree is correct. Do not wire into check-all.mjs.

skippedDirectories.node_modules: vendored third-party dependencies — not our design system
skippedDirectories..next: Next.js build output — a compiled copy of source already walked
skippedDirectories..wrangler: local Cloudflare build cache — regenerated, never edited
skippedDirectories.dist: deploy staging — a copy of files already walked at their source path
skippedDirectories.build: compiled output — a copy of source already walked
skippedDirectories.coverage: test coverage output — regenerated, not shipped

htmlRootsSkipped.docs: internal editorial/handoff prose, excluded from the deploy tar and never served — including the redesign prototypes whose whole point is to look different from the site
htmlRootsSkipped.tests: Playwright fixtures and harness pages — never served
htmlRootsSkipped.assets/vendor: third-party vendored libraries — not our design system

colorLiteralContexts.cssFile: declarations in .css files in either repo
colorLiteralContexts.inlineStyleBlock: declarations inside <style> blocks in storefront HTML
colorLiteralContexts.styleAttr: declarations inside style="" attributes in storefront HTML

scope.notCounted: hex-shaped strings outside a colour position (href="#faq", id="#a1b2c3", url(#grad)) — 57,824 raw regex hits across the HTML, of which only the counted contexts are colour

manifest.verdict: VERIFIED — the shared token manifest is byte-identical in both repos and a wired gate re-asserts the site palette against it

summary.note: Name overlap UNDERSTATES agreement: the two repos deliberately use different names for the same spine (--teal here, --mun-accent-text there). valueBridge below is the honest measure.

instanceVariables._doc: Per-element custom properties set in style="" — figure geometry, not tokens. Bucketed apart so 3.5k chart bars do not read as a design system.

literals._doc: A LITERAL is a hex written directly into a colour-bearing declaration rather than read from a token. onPalette=true means the value equals a token value (right colour, wrong mechanism — a token edit will not reach it). onPalette=false is off-system colour.

nearMisses._doc: Off-palette hexes within 12 summed-RGB of a real token. Invisible in review; survives every redesign.

authoringLayer._doc: Which build script contains each off-palette hex. 88% of colour literals are in per-page <style> blocks that generators emit, so this is the edit list: change the script, re-run the builder, and the drift leaves every page it wrote.
authoringLayer.kindNote: kind=gate means the file CONTAINS the hex (a check script listing values it polices), not that it emits it. Only kind=builder/runtime files write CSS onto pages.

viz._doc: A FIGURE is a <figure> carrying the corpus wrapper class (viz-figure or the pre-Phase-1 article-figure), matched with the same regex check-article-graphics.mjs uses. classOccurrences counts every viz-* class token including BEM children, which is why it is much larger.

brand._doc: role: referenced = some file in the repo names this path; generated-declared = not named by path but its slug is declared in brand/og/cards.json, which build-og-cards.mjs interpolates into a filename; build-input-sibling = the print master behind a referenced sibling (og-image.svg under og-image.png); docs-only = named only in internal handoff prose, which never ships; orphan = none of the above. This script EXCLUDES its own output from the reference scan — the first run counted it and every asset came back "referenced exactly once".

parity.note: The gate enforces parity for the namespaces in gateScope ONLY. Every other namespace is measured here but nothing blocks it. coverage is measured over ALL namespaces.

storefrontCheckScripts._doc: scripts/check-*.mjs excluding the orchestrator check-all.mjs. check-gate-coverage.mjs additionally excludes ITSELF, which is why its own tally reads one lower than this one.

topInconsistencies.what: Raw hex literals that DO equal a token value — right colour, wrong mechanism
topInconsistencies.evidence: 64 distinct hexes; carried by color (13728), background (8100), border-left-color (4332), border-color (3420)
topInconsistencies.consequence: a token edit silently leaves these behind, so the palette drifts apart one theme change at a time

topInconsistencies.what: Raw hex literals that match NO token in either repo — genuinely off-system colour
topInconsistencies.consequence: the real size of the palette is this many colours, not the token count — any redesign that re-pigments only the tokens will leave these standing

topInconsistencies.what: Shipped CSS that is a generated copy of assets/site.css
topInconsistencies.consequence: every measurement of the stylesheet counts the same rule up to twice; edits made in a shell are silently reverted by the next build

topInconsistencies.what: Off-palette hexes within 12 RGB of a real token — drift no eye can catch
topInconsistencies.consequence: these look correct in review and never get fixed, so they survive every redesign

topInconsistencies.what: The token palette is re-declared inside a per-page <style> block instead of being inherited from one stylesheet
topInconsistencies.evidence: 2165 <style> blocks across 1327 pages; 10868 token declarations live in HTML
topInconsistencies.consequence: changing one brand colour requires rebuilding and redeploying every page, so the palette can only move at the speed of a full site rebuild

topInconsistencies.what: Figure elements carrying neither corpus wrapper class, so no graphics gate can see them
topInconsistencies.evidence: 793 <figure> on the site, 396 in the vocabulary; top outside classes: ci-index (160); ci-season-curve (158); (no class) (49); panel (9)
topInconsistencies.consequence: check-article-graphics enforces nine quality rules over a minority of the site’s figures; the rest are ungoverned

topInconsistencies.what: Distinct font-size values in use — there is no type scale, only a list
topInconsistencies.evidence: units: px 51899, clamp() 3528, em 506, pt 89, var() 37, rem 11, keyword 2
topInconsistencies.consequence: a type scale cannot be enforced or changed globally because no token names any step of it

topInconsistencies.what: Tokens defined with more than one value across the storefront (theme flips plus genuine forks)
topInconsistencies.consequence: a token with N values is N tokens wearing one name — nobody can predict what --x resolves to without knowing the page

topInconsistencies.what: Files under brand/ that nothing references, no manifest declares, and no referenced sibling explains
topInconsistencies.evidence: 1328 brand files; 596 referenced, 604 declared in brand/og/cards.json, 35 print masters
topInconsistencies.consequence: brand/ cannot serve as the source of truth for what the brand looks like while this share of it is unreachable

topInconsistencies.what: Product microcopy namespaces with no EN/ES parity gate
topInconsistencies.evidence: gate covers items, landing; 142 EN keys have no ES mirror outside the gated namespaces
topInconsistencies.consequence: the Spanish surface can silently fall behind everywhere the gate is not looking

topInconsistencies.what: Distinct font-family stacks in use where the system declares three token stacks
topInconsistencies.consequence: every non-var() stack is a place a font change will not reach

topInconsistencies.what: viz-* families defined in CSS but carrying zero figures, or used in HTML with no CSS rule
topInconsistencies.consequence: the documented graphic vocabulary is larger than the one in use, so authors pick from a menu half of which is untested
